title: SmartSubs Pro v2.9.6
notes: Templates and text options, fixed. Template names are now a real dropdown listing only the Text+ title templates in your Media Pool, and a new 'Use my template's own styling' option keeps your Sub_Simple / Sub_Hook exactly as you built them, filling in only the text and the karaoke highlight. Remove punctuation now works in every mode (karaoke included), hook captions take the highlight color outside karaoke too, caption timing snaps to the nearest frame, and a failed Gemini hook detection now tells you instead of silently picking random words.
